But the reading order is broken: the CTA sits above the headline and the '24 HOURS' eyebrow has dropped below the body copy. The Inkwell & Lantern logo is shrunk to an illegible speck in the bottom-left corner, which hurts the brand. B: the book is shrunk to a minor thumbnail and pushed against the card edge.
